summary: At line 284, json.dumps(admitted_skills, sort_keys=True) is called on a list. sort_keys=True only sorts dict object keys — it has no effect on list element order. The admitted_skills list (built at line 281 from dict.keys()) is emitted in dict insertion order (Python 3.7+ guarantee), NOT alphabetical order. The sort_keys=True hint signals deterministic intent but silently fails to achieve it. For multi-skill libraries (2+ admitted skills), prompt content order is admission-time order, not a stable canonical order. The 200-iteration replay determinism check (make anti-regression) passes only because the bootstrap library has one skill; a two-skill library with skills admitted in different orders across serialization paths would produce different prompt hashes — breaking replay determinism.
